This petition is filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. by accused No.4 to enlarge him on bail in S.C.No.7/2022 pending on the file of the IV Additional District and Sessions Judge, Dharwad,
arising out of Crime No.59/2021 of Alnavar Police Station.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Charge sheet is filed against accused Nos.1 to 4 for the offence punishable under Sections 498A,
302, 109, 120B, 201, 203 read with Section 34 of IPC.
The NC: 2024:KHC-D:3824 petitioner was arrested on 27.07.2021 and since then, he is in judicial custody.
4. Brief facts:
The deceased, Bibifatima is the wife of accused No.1.
Accused Nos.2 and 3 are the parents of accused No.1.
Accused No.4 i.e., the present petitioner, is the brother of accused No.1.
The accused were subjecting the deceased to physical and mental cruelty stating that she has not given birth to any child and they were making unlawful demands, etc.
After she gave birth to a female child, they started taunting her saying that she do not know the house hold work etc., and forcing her to bring money from her parental home.
On 24.07.2021, during night hours, they strangulated her with a cable wire and committed her murder.
5. Crl.P.No.103519/2022 preferred by the present petitioner before this Court was dismissed on 18.01.2023.

6. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that except the petitioner herein, all other accused are NC: 2024:KHC-D:3824 enlarged on bail and accused No.1, who is similarly placed as the present petitioner, is also granted bail by this Court and therefore, he seeks to enlarge the petitioner on bail Dadapeer S/O Mabusubani ... vs The State Of Karnataka on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54143975/

sentences.text: under changed circumstances.

7. As per charge sheet allegations, accused Nos.1 and 4 strangulated the deceased using a cable wire,
while accused Nos.2 and 3, parents-in-law of the deceased, held her legs tightly.
However, there are no eyewitnesses to the incident.
The case is based on circumstantial evidence.
The petitioner is the brother of accused No.1.
Overt acts of petitioner/accused No.4 and accused No.1 are similar.
8. Co-ordinate bench of this Court in Crl.P.No.103013/2023 vide order dated 22.11.2023 has enlarged accused No.1 on bail.
The said order is passed subsequent to the order dated 18.01.2023 passed by this Court rejecting the bail petition filed by the petitioner.
Accused Nos.2 and 3 are already enlarged on bail.

Since similarly placed accused No.1 has been enlarged on bail, NC:
2024:KHC-D:3824 petitioner is entitled for the relief sought in this petition on the ground of parity.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER Petition is allowed.

Petitioner-accused No.4 shall be released on bail in SC.No.7/2022 pending on the file of IV Additional District and Sessions Judge, Dharwad (Crime No.59/2021 of Alnavar Police Station), subject to following conditions:
1.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, Dharwad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: He shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One lakh only) with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the learned Session Judge.

2. He shall furnish proof of his residential address and shall inform the Investigating Officer/Court, if there is any change in address.
3. He shall not directly or indirectly tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
He shall not indulge himself in committing any offence.
5. He shall appear before the Trial Court regularly.
6. Violation of any of the above conditions will lead to cancellation of the bail.
